title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-05 12:21:28 最新章节：第2364章 尽在掌控静等虫皇
content_zh:
群山之间，有一条小溪。
此刻在这条小溪的一块石头上正有一只漆黑的癞蛤蟆一脸愣神地看着面前的两块乳白色的石头。
莫凡手绘
“半年了！”
“整整半年了，你知道我这半年是怎么挺过来的吗？！”
莫凡在心中呐喊，一双蛤蟆眼都忍不住有些热泪盈眶起来，心中说不出的激动。
他来到这个世界已经足足半年了，从最开始的小蝌蚪找妈妈，直到现在他才总算是弄明白了脑海里那一枚金钱币的用途。
此时在莫凡面前的这块石头上便摆放着一枚金色的钱币。
钱币为圆形，内有方孔，其上刻着四个繁奥的字符，看起来有些像是符纹，总之莫凡是不认识的。
这枚金钱币是随他一起来到这个世界的，也是他坚信的金手指。
然而在这半年间，除了发现这枚金钱币能够随心意收入自己脑海之外，便再没有发现任何闪光点。
莫凡对此自然不死心，他不甘心一直就这样当个癞蛤蟆过完这一生。
当然，他也有想过自杀，但架不住胆小，最终决定好死不如赖活着。
在他看来，哪怕是当蛤蟆，也得当个能吃上天鹅肉的蛤蟆，才不枉此生。
就这样，在这半年中他除了不断的躲避天敌外，便是捣鼓自己的这枚金钱币。
现在，终于被他发现了用途！
竟然能够复制……石头？
不过这种石头并不是一般的石头，莫凡也是第一次见到。
这是他从附近一个溶洞中找来的，看起来像是玉石一样，通体乳白色，夜里还会散发出莹莹光泽，握在爪趾里触感也是冰冰凉凉，和其它石头都不一样。
而且他隐约感觉到靠近这块石头让自己有一种很舒服的错觉。

也正是因为这个原因，所以莫凡才将这块石头含在了嘴里，打算叼回洞穴中做装饰。
可哪知他刚回到小溪边上，就突然感觉脑海里的那枚金钱币微微绽放出了一抹光亮，紧接着嘴里便似乎又多出了一个东西，这吐出来一看却发现神奇的多了一块石头！
由之前的一块石头，变成了现在的两块石头。
打量了一番面前的金钱币，莫凡便心念一动，又将其收回了脑海中，然后张口将面前其中一块石头也含在了嘴里。
他打算再做一次实验，来看看是否如自己所想的那样。
就这样，他含着乳白色的石头静静的等待着，同时在心中盘算着时间。
大约一刻钟的时间，脑海中的那枚金钱币果然再度散发出微微金色光亮，紧接着莫凡便察觉到口中又顿时多出一物！
他连忙将口中之物吐出，果然发现又是两块石头！
看着面前三块一模一样的石头，莫凡心中有些莫名惊喜，旋即眼珠一转，口中猩红舌头却是骤然间飞出，直接卷住了一只在面前不停飞舞的蚊子，闪电般缩回嘴里。
既然能够复制石头，那么其他东西是否也能够复制？
就这样，莫凡口含蚊子，安静的等待着。
至于会不会膈应这种蚊虫，他却是早就不在乎了，因为如果在乎也早就被饿死了。
没办法，这一世既然投胎成了蛤蟆，就注定不能像人类一样挑三拣四了，这是莫凡在这半年里做出的最大觉悟！
然而时间渐渐过去，一刻钟、两刻钟……莫凡最终放弃了，直接将口中的蚊子吞入腹中，勉强算是吃个小点心了。
“看来无法复制蚊子……那么其他的东西呢？”
莫凡心中暗道，旋即又做了好几次实验，什么小草、树叶、鱼虾，甚至连普通石头也全都做了实验。
content_en:
Between the mountains, there is a small stream.
At this moment, there is a pitch-black toad on a stone in this creek, looking blankly at the two milky-white stones in front of it.
Mo Fan hand-painted
"Half a year!"
"It's been half a year. Do you know how I survived this half year?!"
Mo Fan shouted in his heart, his toad eyes couldn't help but burst into tears, and he felt indescribable excitement in his heart.
It has been half a year since he came to this world. From the very beginning when he was a tadpole looking for his mother, it was only now that he finally figured out the purpose of the coin in his mind.
At this time, there was a golden coin placed on the stone in front of Mo Fan.
The coin was round in shape with a square hole inside. It was engraved with four complicated characters that looked like runes, but Mo Fan didn't recognize them.
This gold coin came to this world with him, and it was also the golden finger he firmly believed in.
However, in the past six months, apart from the discovery that this coin can be put into my mind at will, I have not found any bright spots.
Mo Fan naturally refused to give up on this. He was not willing to live his whole life like a toad.
Of course, he also thought about committing suicide, but he couldn't stand his timidity and finally decided that it was better to live than to die.
In his opinion, even if he is a toad, he must be a toad that can eat swan meat to live his life in vain.
In this way, during the past six months, in addition to constantly avoiding natural enemies, he also tinkered with his own coin.
Now, he finally discovered its use!
Can actually copy... stones?
However, this kind of stone is not an ordinary stone, and this is the first time Mo Fan has seen it.
He found this from a nearby cave. It looked like jade, and was milky white in color. It also exuded a gleaming luster at night. It felt cold to the touch when held in his claws, which was different from other stones.
And he vaguely felt that being close to this stone gave him a very comfortable illusion.
It was precisely for this reason that Mo Fan put the stone in his mouth, intending to take it back to the cave for decoration.
But as soon as he returned to the creek, he suddenly felt that the coin in his mind was shining with light, and then something seemed to appear in his mouth. When he spit it out, he found that there was a magical extra stone!
From one stone before, it became two stones now.
After looking at the coins in front of him, Mo Fan thought about it and took it back into his mind, then opened his mouth and took one of the stones in front of him.
He planned to do another experiment to see if it was what he thought.
In this way, he waited quietly with the milky white stone in his mouth, while calculating the time in his heart.
After about a quarter of an hour, the coin in his mind once again emitted a faint golden light, and then Mo Fan noticed that there was another thing in his mouth!
He quickly spit out what was in his mouth, and sure enough he found two more stones!
Looking at the three identical stones in front of him, Mo Fan was inexplicably surprised. He rolled his eyes and suddenly a scarlet tongue flew out of his mouth. He directly caught a mosquito that was flying in front of him and retracted it into his mouth like lightning.
Since stones can be copied, can other things also be copied?
Just like that, Mo Fan waited quietly with the mosquito in his mouth.
As for whether he could cope with such mosquitoes, he didn't care for a long time, because if he did, he would have starved to death long ago.
There is no other way. Since I was reincarnated as a toad in this life, I am destined not to be picky like humans. This is the biggest realization Mo Fan has made in the past six months!
However, time gradually passed, a quarter of an hour, two quarters of an hour... Mo Fan finally gave up and swallowed the mosquito in his mouth directly, barely eating a snack.
"It seems like mosquitoes can't be copied... so what about other things?"
In Mo Fan's heartHe secretly thought, and immediately conducted several more experiments on grass, leaves, fish and shrimps, and even ordinary stones.
